workflow_sequence.description: A Cadence Worker begins a skill Activity attempt and establishes the existing workflow-aware logging context using sanitized workflow, run, Activity, and attempt identity. The story changes current reality by making the attempt's containing artifact directory available through the common logging contract.

handshake_points.data_shape: Cadence activity identity: workflow_id, workflow_run_id, activity_type, activity_id, attempt

workflow_sequence.description: The generic SkillActivity builds the prompt, enters skill invocation context, and calls the configured Harness exactly as it does today. No cost-specific behavior is added to the workflow package or SkillActivity result contract.

handshake_points.data_shape: prompt: str, cwd: Path, config: Mapping[str, object]

workflow_sequence.description: DevinHarness validates its namespaced invocation profile and selects an absolute ATIF export path. It uses devin-trajectory.json in the current attempt-scoped artifact directory when one exists; otherwise it creates a temporary directory whose lifecycle encloses subprocess execution and parsing.

DevinHarness invokes the host Devin CLI non-interactively with --export while preserving the existing model, permission mode, prompt boundary, working directory, stdout, stderr, launch-error behavior, and process exit code.

handshake_points.data_shape: returncode: int, stdout: str, stderr: str; optional ATIF file side effect

workflow_sequence.description: After any normal subprocess completion, the parser reads the export defensively and inspects only the aggregate final_metrics object. Valid standard fields become an immutable HarnessUsage; missing, unreadable, malformed, or structurally invalid telemetry produces no usage without altering the process result. Unknown billing dimensions remain solely in the retained raw export.

handshake_points.data_shape: JSON object with optional final_metrics object
HarnessUsage(prompt_tokens: int | None, completion_tokens: int | None, cached_tokens: int | None, cost_usd: float | None) | None

workflow_sequence.description: DevinHarness returns HarnessResult with the original process fields and optional usage. For temporary mode, parsing completes before cleanup; for Activity mode, the raw trajectory remains beside activity.log and devin.log for operator audit. SkillActivity continues evaluating exit_code and sentinel behavior unchanged.

handshake_points.data_shape: HarnessResult(exit_code: int, stdout: str, stderr: str, usage: HarnessUsage | None = None)
Durable attempt-scoped ATIF retained; temporary ATIF removed with its temporary directory

instrumentation_events.description: Records that an export destination was selected without logging prompts or trajectory content.

data_points.description: Either activity_artifact or temporary; safe for operational correlation.
The selected path when existing logging policy permits paths; never trajectory content.
Canonical skill identity already available in invocation context.

instrumentation_events.description: Extends the sanitized completion observation with whether normalized usage was available while preserving existing subprocess outcome semantics.

data_points.description: Boolean indicating whether a structurally valid aggregate was normalized.

instrumentation_events.description: Reports a sanitized telemetry failure category; it is observational and never changes HarnessResult.exit_code.

data_points.description: One of missing_export, unreadable_export, malformed_json, invalid_document, or invalid_final_metrics; excludes exception text and raw content.
Whether the rejected export was activity-scoped or temporary.

instrumentation_events.description: Records successful normalization without copying token values, costs, prompts, tool calls, or raw ATIF into normal Activity logs.

data_points.description: Names of supported standard fields that passed type validation, not their values.
Count of unnormalized metric fields, without names or values if they may be producer-sensitive.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Establish an Activity-attempt-scoped artifact context and expose its directory through get_activity_artifact_dir().
new_responsibilities.intent: Cadence identity is available when Activity logging begins, and this layer already owns sanitization, directory layout, concurrency isolation, and retry-attempt isolation.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Migrate the reusable path-aware logger behavior from orchestrator into common without importing workflow packages or the composition root.
new_responsibilities.intent: ADR-013 assigns generic logging mechanics to common and forbids reverse dependencies.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Request an ATIF export on every non-interactive Devin invocation.
new_responsibilities.intent: The harness is the only layer that constructs the Devin CLI command and knows the invocation lifecycle.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Choose durable versus temporary export storage and keep temporary storage alive through parsing.
new_responsibilities.intent: The harness has both the optional logging context and the subprocess boundary needed to guarantee consistent capture for all callers.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Return optional normalized usage without changing stdout, stderr, exit_code, or launch failure semantics.
new_responsibilities.intent: The harness owns the process-to-HarnessResult translation and can preserve backward compatibility at that boundary.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Parse only final_metrics and normalize supported standard token and USD fields defensively.
new_responsibilities.intent: Metric type information originates in the ATIF document; isolating pure normalization from subprocess control makes malformed telemetry independently testable.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Reject booleans as numeric values, normalize integer USD values to float, preserve valid sibling fields, and return None for invalid documents or final_metrics containers.
new_responsibilities.intent: This layer has the parsed values needed to enforce the stable HarnessUsage contract without failing the invocation.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Define frozen HarnessUsage and add usage: HarnessUsage | None = None to frozen HarnessResult.
new_responsibilities.intent: The common model is the workflow-agnostic contract shared by real, fake, and future harness implementations; the default preserves existing three-field construction.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Persist raw ATIF in an existing attempt-scoped Activity artifact directory or temporary directory selected by the harness.
new_responsibilities.intent: Raw trajectories are file artifacts, not relational application data; no database, API, or frontend is introduced by this story.

new_responsibilities.responsibility: Retain Activity-scoped exports and remove out-of-context temporary exports after parsing.
new_responsibilities.intent: This is the smallest storage change consistent with auditability and the explicit exclusion of a new retention service or policy.

contracts.name: HarnessUsage
contracts.description: Immutable normalized aggregate metrics for one Devin harness invocation; absent or invalid individual fields are represented as None rather than zero.

changes.added: frozen dataclass HarnessUsage(prompt_tokens: int | None = None, completion_tokens: int | None = None, cached_tokens: int | None = None, cost_usd: float | None = None)
changes.removed: No fields; producer-specific and unstable billing dimensions are deliberately not added and remain in raw ATIF.

contracts.name: HarnessResultWithUsage
contracts.description: Backward-compatible result for one Harness invocation.

changes.added: usage: HarnessUsage | None = None as the final field
changes.modified: Existing exit_code, stdout, and stderr semantics remain unchanged.

contracts.name: ActivityArtifactContext
contracts.description: Common logging API through which infrastructure consumers obtain the current attempt's artifact directory without deriving it from a log filename.

changes.added: get_activity_artifact_dir() -> Path | None and Activity context state containing an absolute attempt-scoped artifact directory
changes.modified: common.workflow_logger gains generalized path-aware Activity and Devin file logging migrated from the legacy orchestrator implementation.
changes.removed: No public behavior required by worker route logging; legacy orchestrator duplication may be removed only after consumers and tests migrate.

contracts.name: ATIFUsageNormalization
contracts.description: Pure best-effort conversion from an ATIF export path to supported aggregate usage.

changes.added: read_atif_usage(path: Path) -> HarnessUsage | None in a dedicated common module; supported source keys are total_prompt_tokens, total_completion_tokens, total_cached_tokens, and total_cost_usd.
changes.removed: No unknown fields are deleted from disk; they are simply excluded from the normalized object.

contracts.name: DevinCLIExportInvocation
contracts.description: Every DevinHarness command requests an absolute-path ATIF export before the existing permission, model, and prompt arguments.

changes.modified: Command assembly and temporary-directory lifecycle now enclose post-process ATIF parsing.
changes.removed: No existing CLI arguments or subprocess capture options.

contracts.name: BestEffortTelemetry
contracts.description: Telemetry is observational: parse outcomes cannot replace, mask, or modify a normally returned Devin process result.

changes.added: Post-completion parse step and sanitized telemetry diagnostics.
changes.modified: HarnessResult may include usage for either zero or nonzero Devin exits.
changes.removed: No existing devin_launch_failed behavior, SkillActivity exit handling, sentinel handling, or stdout/stderr behavior.

architectural_decisions.decision: Export raw ATIF for every common.DevinHarness invocation and normalize only the four supported standard aggregate metrics.
architectural_decisions.justification: Unconditional capture makes invocation behavior consistent, while a narrow typed result remains stable and raw ATIF preserves additional billing dimensions for later use.
architectural_decisions.impact: src/common/devin_harness.py, new common ATIF parser, common harness models, and tests
architectural_decisions.answers_open_question: Resolves how to handle producer-specific credit, ACU, or extra billing fields: retain them only in raw ATIF in this story.

architectural_decisions.decision: Treat ATIF final_metrics as invocation aggregates inclusive of subagent usage and do not parse step-level or subagent-level metrics.
architectural_decisions.justification: This keeps the story bounded to one stable aggregate per harness call and avoids double counting while actual vendor semantics remain to be characterized.
architectural_decisions.impact: ATIF parser semantics and downstream interpretation of HarnessUsage
architectural_decisions.answers_open_question: Assumes subagent usage is included in aggregate totals; characterization may revise a future contract but does not block this implementation.

architectural_decisions.decision: Complete the path-aware logger migration into common and expose the Activity attempt directory explicitly rather than deriving it from activity.log or devin.log paths.
architectural_decisions.justification: Common DevinHarness cannot import orchestrator, and the logging layer owns Cadence identity sanitization and attempt-scoped directory allocation.
architectural_decisions.basis: ADR-013, ADR-015, and the existing src/orchestrator/workflow_logger.py pattern
architectural_decisions.impact: src/common/workflow_logger.py, Activity integration, public common exports, migration tests, and eventual removal of legacy duplication
architectural_decisions.answers_open_question: Confirms the existing legacy layout isolates retries by including attempt and assigns migration to common.

architectural_decisions.decision: Use a fixed devin-trajectory.json name inside an attempt-scoped directory and temporary storage outside Activity context.
architectural_decisions.justification: Current generic SkillActivity performs one harness call per Activity attempt, so attempt identity is a sufficient non-overwriting discriminator; temporary storage gives non-workflow callers equivalent parsing without durable orphan artifacts.
architectural_decisions.impact: Export path selection, context management, concurrency/retry tests, and artifact layout
architectural_decisions.answers_open_question: Assumes one DevinHarness invocation per generic SkillActivity.execute call; a future multi-invocation Activity must add an invocation discriminator.

architectural_decisions.decision: Keep telemetry failures non-fatal and log only sanitized categories and safe correlation data.
architectural_decisions.justification: Cost observation must never turn successful work into failure, and trajectories may contain prompts, tool calls, file paths, credentials, or other sensitive operational context.
architectural_decisions.basis: ADR-015, vault/services/orchestrator-harness.md, and proposed architecture security requirements
architectural_decisions.impact: Parser return contract, DevinHarness control flow, logging events, and malformed/missing/unwriteable export tests
architectural_decisions.answers_open_question: Establishes behavior for missing files, malformed JSON, invalid metric types, filesystem errors, and nonzero Devin exits.

architectural_decisions.decision: Do not add frontend, database, external metrics service, SkillActivity output cost fields, workflow aggregation, pricing derivation, or a new retention configuration.
architectural_decisions.justification: The smallest next step captures one invocation at the existing harness boundary and stores the authoritative raw artifact under the existing log root; higher-level reporting depends on this contract and is explicitly deferred.
architectural_decisions.basis: ADR-015 and story analysis definition of done
architectural_decisions.impact: No changes outside common logging/harness infrastructure and its runtime integration are required for this story.
architectural_decisions.answers_open_question: Defers reporting surface, aggregate workflow cost, retention period, and organization billing policy to later stories.

questions_addressed.question: Where should a trajectory be stored for a harness call inside a Cadence Activity?
questions_addressed.answer: As devin-trajectory.json in the current sanitized Activity-attempt artifact directory beside activity.log and devin.log.
questions_addressed.justification: The legacy path-aware logger already associates workflow, run, Activity, and attempt and prevents concurrent/retry overwrites.

questions_addressed.question: How should a harness call outside Activity logging context capture usage?
questions_addressed.answer: Create a temporary directory, pass its absolute export path to Devin, parse before context exit, and retain no durable path.
questions_addressed.justification: Tests and diagnostic callers should receive the same normalized usage without being forced to initialize Cadence logging or leaving durable artifacts.

questions_addressed.question: What happens when ATIF is absent, unreadable, malformed, structurally invalid, partially populated, or contains wrong-typed fields?
questions_addressed.answer: Invalid document/final_metrics structure returns usage None; a valid aggregate returns HarnessUsage with each absent or invalid field set to None and valid sibling fields preserved. In all cases, the original process result is unchanged.
questions_addressed.justification: Unknown telemetry is not zero usage and observational failures must not become workflow failures.
questions_addressed.basis: Acceptance criteria and edge cases in capture-devin-cost-metrics.analysis.json

questions_addressed.question: Should booleans count as integers and should integer USD costs be accepted?
questions_addressed.answer: Reject booleans for token and cost fields; accept int or float cost values except booleans and normalize accepted USD values to float.
questions_addressed.justification: Python bool is an int subtype but semantically invalid usage, while a producer may validly serialize whole-dollar cost as an integer.

questions_addressed.question: Should additional billing dimensions be exposed in HarnessUsage?
questions_addressed.answer: No. Normalize only prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cached_tokens, and cost_usd; retain all other dimensions in raw ATIF.
questions_addressed.justification: Unknown vendor-specific dimensions do not yet have a stable semantic contract and must not be mislabeled as USD.

questions_addressed.question: Can a fixed filename overwrite another invocation?
questions_addressed.answer: Not under the current invariant of one Harness.run per SkillActivity.execute and an artifact directory containing Activity attempt identity. Add an invocation discriminator if a future Activity makes multiple calls in one attempt.
questions_addressed.justification: Concurrency and retries are already separated by the legacy path layout; avoiding an unused ID is the smallest change from current reality.

questions_addressed.question: Should telemetry errors or a valid export from a failed Devin process alter exit handling?
questions_addressed.answer: No. Parse after every normal completion, including nonzero exits, populate usage when possible, and preserve the exact subprocess exit code. Preserve existing devin_launch_failed behavior for launch OSError.
questions_addressed.justification: Failed invocations can incur cost, but telemetry cannot mask or manufacture execution success or failure.
questions_addressed.basis: Acceptance criteria in capture-devin-cost-metrics.analysis.json and sanitized failure precedent in vault/services/orchestrator-harness.md

questions_addressed.question: Does this design stray from the current architecture?
questions_addressed.answer: No intentional architectural departure. It completes the already-approved staged migration of generic path-aware logging from orchestrator to common and extends the common Harness result compatibly.
questions_addressed.justification: Generic infrastructure remains in common, workflow packages remain consumers, and orchestrator remains the composition root.
